keyPoints.en: Remove the quotation marks and add "that".
Change pronouns: I → he/she, my → his/her.
keyPoints.hi: सर्वनाम बदलो: I → he/she, my → his/her।

keyPoints.en: If the reporting verb is past (said), move the tense back: am → was, is → was, will → would.
keyPoints.hi: Reporting verb past (said) हो तो tense पीछे: am → was, is → was, will → would।

problem.en: Change to indirect: Meena said, "I am tired."
problem.hi: Indirect में बदलो: Meena said, "I am tired."

answer.en: Meena said that she was tired.
answer.hi: Meena said that she was tired.

problem.en: Change to indirect: The boy said, "I will go home."
problem.hi: Indirect में बदलो: The boy said, "I will go home."

answer.en: The boy said that he would go home.
answer.hi: The boy said that he would go home.

question.en: Change to indirect: Aman said, "I like cricket."
question.hi: Indirect में बदलो: Aman said, "I like cricket."

answer.en: Aman said that he liked cricket.
answer.hi: Aman said that he liked cricket.

question.en: In indirect speech, what word usually joins the two parts?
question.hi: Indirect speech में दोनों हिस्से कौन-सा शब्द जोड़ता है?

question.en: Change to indirect: Priya said, "My dog is sick."
question.hi: Indirect में बदलो: Priya said, "My dog is sick."

answer.en: Priya said that her dog was sick.
answer.hi: Priya said that her dog was sick.

intro.en: Direct speech gives the exact words inside quotation marks: Ravi said, "I am hungry." Indirect (reported) speech tells what was said without quotes: Ravi said that he was hungry.
intro.hi: Direct speech सटीक शब्द उद्धरण चिह्नों में देती है: Ravi said, "I am hungry." Indirect (reported) speech बिना उद्धरण बताती है क्या कहा: Ravi said that he was hungry।
